## Outcome

What should an Sjel operator be able to do?

## Consumer

Name the actual workflow. Then identify the capability that owns it and explain why the current
contract cannot serve that consumer without widening another owner's boundary.

## Ownership boundary

State which capability owns the data and where public code ends. Keep personal values, deployment
facts, and secret wiring in a private overlay issue.

## Acceptance

Write the shortest observable conditions that would prove the change works. A reviewer should be
able to reject the implementation while accepting the outcome.

## Alternatives and provenance

Link relevant upstream projects or prior art. Say what Sjel would adopt and what it would leave
outside the repository.
